title: Bracewell probe possibly lurking in the solar system

tellings.quote: Bracewell took his speculation one step further by considering that such a probe may already be lurking somewhere in the dark recesses of our solar system,

plain: In the 1960s a scientist named Ronald Bracewell imagined that an alien civilisation might send a robot probe to watch other star systems, and he went further: such a probe, Michels says, "may already be lurking somewhere in the dark recesses of our solar system," perhaps at the balance points between the Earth's and the Moon's gravity. Michels tells this himself, framing his conversation with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, without naming a source beyond Bracewell. If true, an alien watcher could be parked close to home.
